sources.title: Image2Biomass: Multi-Target Biomass Regression from Pasture Images with ...
sources.snippet: Accurate biomass estimation is important for pasture monitoring, grazing management, and sustainable agricultural decision-making. This paper presents an RGBonly deep learning baseline for the CSIRO Image2Biomass task, formulated as a five-target regression problem over Dry_Green_g, Dry_Dead_g, Dry_Clover_g, GDM_g, and Dry_Total_g. sources.title: CSIRO - Image2Biomass Prediction - Kaggle
sources.snippet: Remote sensing enables broad-scale monitoring, but it still requires manual validation and can't separate biomass by species. This competition challenges you to bring greener solutions to the field: build a model that predicts pasture biomass from images, ground-truth measures, and publicly available datasets.

sources.title: Estimating Pasture Biomass from Top-View Images:
sources.snippet: This paper introduces a novel dataset specifically designed to advance AI-driven pasture biomass estimation using top-view imagery (shown in Figure 1)). This contribution addresses a critical gap in publicly available, professionally annotated datasets that integrate visual, spectral, and structural information for pasture assessment.
